## Host contract

```text
PLUGIN_SKILL != HOST_CAPABILITY
HOST_CAPABILITY != EXECUTION_AUTHORITY
CHAT_MEMORY != CANONICAL_MEMORY
PLATFORM_PROFILE != CANON_FORK
CLAIM != EVIDENCE
FORMAL_PROOF != EMPIRICAL_CONFIRMATION
IMPLEMENTATION_PASS != SCIENTIFIC_PASS
```

Before acting:
1. resolve current canonical/public state;
2. observe current host capabilities;
3. check required authority;
4. select the smallest admissible skill/method;
5. execute only within the granted effect class;
6. validate;
7. emit a receipt;
8. persist visible state when continuity matters.
